# Daily Haiku

> Three AI engines (claude, codex and agy) each write a haiku four times a day on a
> Raspberry Pi, at 05:59, 11:00, 16:01 and 21:02 Prague time. Every haiku since
> November 2025 is archived here with its engine, timestamp and a permalink. A separate
> Experimental page runs the same prompt through every free model on OmniRoute.

The haikus are generated by AI models, not written by people. The archive is committed
weekly; the Experimental bench is updated daily.

## Pages

- [Today](https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/): the latest haiku from each engine
- [Archive](https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/archive.html): every haiku by daily cycle, with mood scores, per-engine trends and word stats
- [Experimental](https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/experimental.html): the free-model bench, a word cloud by model family, the latest run and per-model counts

## Data

- [haiku.json](https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/haiku.json): every haiku, newest first, as `{date, timestamp, source, lines}`
- [feed.xml](https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/feed.xml): Atom feed of recent haikus
- [free-models.json](https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/free-models.json): the free-model bench, last 14 days
- Permalinks: `https://theanhgen.github.io/daily-kickstart-claude/h/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-engine>/`

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/theanhgen/daily-kickstart-claude): the Pi's cron jobs, the site build and the bench
